title: 1Password lets AI agents use your passwords without seeing them
slides: What if an AI knew your passwords but never saw them?
1Password built a vault that gates secrets behind policy
Agents authenticate without ever holding plaintext credentials
Your team must define which agents get which secrets
Audit every agent action before granting vault access
thread_text:
1. Your passwords, never seen

1Password's AI agents authenticate without ever holding plaintext credentials—the vault does the work behind the scenes.

2. Policy becomes the gatekeeper

A vault gates each secret behind rules your team writes. No policy match, no access—even for an agent.

3. Define who gets what

Your team maps every agent to its allowed secrets. Without this map, the vault is just a locked box.

4. Audit before you grant

Every agent action is logged for review before vault access is granted. The audit trail becomes your safety net.

5. Test it on one agent

Take a low-risk secret and simulate an agent request. If your policy doesn't block it, start there.
